_comment: Input for the apify/website-content-crawler actor. n8n overwrites startUrls with the competitor's page_urls at runtime. Field names verified against the actor's published input schema.
_comment_crawlerType: adaptive, not cheerio: Toast/Popmenu/Square menu widgets render prices client-side, and a JS-free crawl returns markdown with the menu body missing, which the diff reads as 'no change' instead of an error.
